children: Alexander Fink, an Officer and Director, reported a sale and is listed as President and Chief Executive Officer (U.S.). The filing states a weighted average selling price of $22.593 per share for the transactions. The total reported sale amount was $1,362,990. Following the reported sale, the reporter directly owned 2,692,487 shares of common stock. The filing notes the 60,328 shares sold were to satisfy tax withholding on vested restricted stock units and were executed via multiple transactions at prices ranging from $22.02 to $24.00.
